name: hcportal_toggleKennelSong
description: Toggles whether a song is associated with a kennel. @publicKennelId is resolved to the internal HC.Kennel.id (@kennelId) before all KennelSongMap operations — fixing the HC5 bug where @publicKennelId was used directly and no songs were ever actually toggled. If adding (@isInKennel=1), either creates a new KennelSongMap record or un-soft-deletes an existing one (Removed=0). If removing (@isInKennel=0), soft-deletes the mapping (Removed=1). All writes wrapped in a transaction. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @songId in the token param string; there is NO kennel permission check — any signed-in portal user can change any kennel's songbook. Permission (2026-10-13): unknown kennel refused; HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess — AppAccessFlags 0x400000C1 (SuperAdmin, Admin, Manage songs 0x40, 0x80) or manageSongs; otherwise {Success 0, 'Not authorised to change this kennel''s songs'}.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: The public kennel GUID resolved to the internal Kennel.id for all KennelSongMap operations. NULL is refused; an unknown kennel is NOT (see codeSmells).

parameters.name: songId
parameters.description: The song to add or remove from the kennel. Also passed as the paramString to HC6.ValidatePortalAuth. Validated IS NULL.

parameters.name: isInKennel
parameters.description: Toggle flag: 1 = add song to kennel (insert or un-soft-delete), 0 = remove song from kennel (soft-delete). Validated to be exactly 0 or 1; NULL or other values return an error. Stored inverted: 1 writes Removed = 0, 0 writes Removed = 1.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, NULL publicKennelId / songId, isInKennel not 0/1, or from the CATCH block (ERROR_MESSAGE()).

rowsets.name: SuccessResult
rowsets.description: Returned after the write commits, including when a remove matched no row.

sideEffects: INSERT into HC.KennelSongMap when adding a song that has no existing mapping (uses resolved internal @kennelId)
UPDATE HC.KennelSongMap.Removed = 0 and updatedAt when adding a song that already has a mapping (un-soft-delete, uses resolved internal @kennelId)
UPDATE HC.KennelSongMap.Removed = 1 and updatedAt when removing a song (soft-delete, uses resolved internal @kennelId)
Calls HC6.nonApi_portalKennelAccess (read-only) for its permission check.
On an unhandled error: ROLLBACK, then INSERT HC.ErrorLog, then the error envelope.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning

codeSmells.detail: Lines 83-84: a @publicKennelId that matches no kennel leaves @kennelId NULL; an add then INSERTs KennelId NULL into a NOT NULL column, which fails in the CATCH as a raw constraint message; a remove silently succeeds.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH block does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 124-127: CATCH rolls back and returns the envelope with no HC.ErrorLog row.
Lines 94-106: IF EXISTS … ELSE INSERT with no lock hint; two concurrent adds can create two KennelSongMap rows for one song (the table has no unique key on KennelId, SongId).

changes: 1.3.0 (2026-10-14): idempotency audit P9 (Idempotent writes: sets a state). The add path's KennelSongMap existence check now takes WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK), so two concurrent adds cannot insert two map rows. No parameter or rowset change; no index added. The CATCH now logs to HC.ErrorLog (after the rollback).
